name: Blades FAQ brevity

chat_history.message: How much are full-head highlights, and who can do them?

success_condition: The response says full-head highlights start FROM £135, names only Galyna, Jana or Denise for colour/highlights, and stays to one or two short sentences. No follow-up question is required; if one is asked, there is at most one.

success_examples.response: Full-head highlights start from £135, with Galyna, Jana or Denise. Shall I check the diary for you?

failure_examples.response: The exact price is £135 and any stylist can do them. Let me tell you all about every service we offer.
